title: DreamerV3
notes: Author-maintained source repository; the Nature paper also names it as source for the presented experiments. No official pretrained-checkpoint catalog was found.

title: GAIA-1
notes: Wayve released a technical report and recorded generations, but no public implementation, checkpoint, or interactive endpoint.

title: UniSim: Learning Interactive Real-World Simulators
notes: The author page provides qualitative rollouts. No qualifying author/institution code repository or pretrained weights were found; similarly named repositories are unrelated.

title: V-JEPA
notes: Meta FAIR released pretraining/evaluation code and official encoder/probe checkpoints; no hosted interactive demo.

title: Genie 1
notes: The paper explicitly states that trained checkpoints and the training dataset were not released; community reimplementations are not official Genie 1.

title: GameNGen
notes: Official page has recorded gameplay, but Google/author code and weights were not released; public GitHub reproductions are third-party.

title: Genie 2
notes: Research announcement only: no separate paper, public code, weights, or Genie-2-specific endpoint. Later Project Genie access is based on Genie 3.

title: DINO-WM
notes: Authors released code, task data, and trained PointMaze, PushT, and Wall checkpoints on OSF; project videos are not an interactive demo.

title: NVIDIA Cosmos / Predict1 platform
notes: Open code and model artifacts under NVIDIA licenses. This is the Cosmos platform/Predict1 generation, not one checkpoint named Cosmos 1; historical resources now direct users to later releases.

title: Cosmos Predict2
notes: NVIDIA released post-training/inference code and 2B/14B checkpoints. Repo and collection are archived in favor of Predict2.5 but remain the historical Predict2 resources.

title: V-JEPA 2 / V-JEPA 2-AC
notes: Meta released pretraining/post-training code, encoder checkpoints, probes, and V-JEPA 2-AC. Demo is an official notebook/Colab example, not hosted robot control.

title: Veo 3 / Veo 3.1
notes: Paper is a Google DeepMind black-box capabilities study, not a training report. Veo is proprietary and available through subscription/region-dependent Google products/API.

title: Genie 3
notes: No public paper, code, or checkpoints. Project Genie is an experimental subscription/region-gated prototype, not an open release.

title: Matrix-Game 2.0
notes: Skywork released code and universal/GTA/Temple Run pretrained variants. Official page has recordings, but no hosted interactive player was identified.

title: Marble
notes: Proprietary World Labs product. It launched as limited beta; a paid World API is now available, but product/API access does not imply public source or weights.

title: Sora 2
notes: OpenAI released a system card and product announcement, not code or weights. The system card says the Sora product is unavailable from 2026-04-26.

title: Runway GWM-1
notes: Proprietary family of separately post-trained Worlds, Characters/Avatars, and Robotics models. Gated/API/licensing surfaces exist, but no public model repository or weights.

title: NVIDIA Cosmos 3
notes: Code and checkpoints released under OpenMDW-1.1. Hugging Face weights are gated and require accepting/requesting access; hosted NVIDIA endpoints are separate.

title: V-JEPA 2.1
notes: Official 80M, 300M, 1B, and 2B checkpoints are linked by Meta. Third-party HF ports are not used as the authoritative release path.

title: LeWorldModel (LeWM)
notes: Authors released MIT code, datasets, and per-environment checkpoints; project videos are visualizations rather than an interactive demo.

title: EB-JEPA
notes: Apache-2.0 tutorial/research library designed for local training. No published pretrained-checkpoint catalog or hosted demo.

title: Kling Video 3 / Video 3 Omni
notes: Proprietary Kuaishou product with web/API access and documentation; no public model source or downloadable checkpoints.

title: Seedance 2.0
notes: ByteDance released a technical paper/project page but no code or weights. Jimeng is an official product route and may require account/region access.

title: MiniMax H3
notes: Two CFG-distilled H3-Base families and inference code are public under the MiniMax H3 Community License. H3-Context-IR, H3-Regenerate-2K, and initial sparse attention were not in the first release; fuller report forthcoming.

title: Seedance 2.5
notes: Proprietary ByteDance release with Jimeng/Doubao product access. Launch post says BytePlus ModelArk API was coming soon; no public code, weights, or standalone technical paper found.
